description.narrative: The overall objective of the BEEKEEP project (Beekeeping Value Chain Support) is that the beekeeping industry is enhanced for inclusive growth, poverty reduction and food security in Tanzania. It's specific objective is to ensure that high quality honey produced in an environmentally sustainable manner leads to increased market penetration. The project focuses on 3 main outputs: (1) Institutional capacity and enabling environment for beekeeping value chain actors is strengthened, while enhancing women’s empowerment (Enabel-Led); (2) Capacities of beekeeping value chain actors improved and management of bee reserves and apiaries enhanced. (Enabel-Led) and (3) Market links and Trade of bee products strengthened (ITC-Led).
